title: Pharos run result (pharos-run/1)
description: Written by the plugin to output_dir/result.json, at most 1 MiB, before exiting 0. complete and partial acknowledge the run: its cursor is stored and returned next time. failed, a non-zero exit, a missing or invalid result, or a drop that fails validation acknowledge nothing.

status.description: complete: nothing more to do for now. partial: stopped at a limit, consistent with cursor; Pharos runs again soon. failed: nothing is acknowledged.

cursor.description: Stored with the acknowledgement and returned in the next request. Ignored when status is failed.

transferred_bytes.description: The plugin's own count of network bytes, shown beside what it dropped or Pharos served.

delivered.description: Exporters: what the plugin says it delivered. Pharos records what it served regardless.

receipt.description: Exporters: the receiver's acknowledgement, kept with the run.

machines.description: Importers: machines the drops came from. Every drop's machine must be one of these keys.

drops.description: Importers: folders of output_dir to adopt. No two drops share a dir, or a machine and source.
